briefdescription.para: This function is used to check if the Cframe data is cleared or not using CRC method.

detaileddescription.para: This function need to be called after CFI house cleaning is done.

parameterdescription.para: is pointer to the command. Command payload parameters are: Block Type

listitem.para: XLOADER_INVALID_BLOCKTYPE if block type passed is invalid. Only Type 0, Type 1, and Type 2 are supported.
XLOADER_CFI_CFRAME_IS_BUSY if CRAM self check fails as CFI CFrame is busy.
XLOADER_CFRAME_CRC_CHECK_FAILED if CFRAME CRC check fails.

XLOADER_ERR_INVALID_ROW_RANGE if CFU row count is zero or the CRC walk does not cover every row. Zero is not a valid row count; it means the CFU is in reset or not configured, and treating it as success would skip the CRAM clear check.
Check if the block type is valid

CFU_ROW_RANGE.NUM is the device row count. No supported device reports zero rows. Zero means the CFU is in reset or has not been configured. A zero count skips the CRC loop and would otherwise return success without proving that CRAM was cleared.
Set Frame Address Register with the Block type
Fail if both counters do not confirm that the CRC walk covered every row. A zero row count is already rejected before the walk.
